exposure: Outpatient cervical ripening using osmotic dilators
Outpatient cervical ripening using Foley balloon catheters
Device type (osmotic dilator vs. Foley balloon catheter)
outcome: Time from insertion to inpatient admission
cohort: The study included 120 patients with a low-risk singleton pregnancy undergoing outpatient cervical ripening with either an osmotic dilator or Foley balloon catheter.
finding: Patients participating in outpatient cervical ripening experienced clinically meaningful changes in dilation and simplified Bishop scores and reported general satisfaction, with comparable clinical outcomes between osmotic dilators and Foley balloon catheters, though satisfaction was highest with osmotic dilators.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred for 74.8% of patients.
